question: The ICAR-Central Institute for Cotton Research is located in _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nagpur**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The ICAR-Central Institute for Cotton Research (CICR) is located in Nagpur, Maharashtra.
 
• CICR is one of the premier institutions under the Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR).
 
• The institute focuses on conducting basic and strategic research on cotton to enhance productivity and profitability.
 
• It aims to develop new cotton varieties and hybrids, improve crop management practices, and address issues related to pests and diseases.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR)**

 
 
• ICAR is an autonomous organization under the Department of Agricultural Research and Education (DARE), Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India.
 
• Established in 1929, ICAR is responsible for coordinating agricultural education and research in India.
 
• It is one of the largest national agricultural systems in the world, encompassing 101 ICAR institutes and 71 agricultural universities.
 
• ICAR plays a pivotal role in promoting sustainable agriculture and ensuring food security in India.
 
 
 
• **Cotton Research in India**
 
 
• India is one of the largest producers and consumers of cotton in the world.
 
• Cotton is a significant cash crop in India, contributing substantially to the country's economy and the textile industry.
 
• Research on cotton in India focuses on developing high-yielding and pest-resistant varieties, improving soil health, and adopting sustainable farming practices.
 
• Institutions like CICR play a vital role in addressing the challenges faced by cotton farmers and enhancing the overall productivity of the crop.
 
 
 
• **Sustainable Cotton Initiative**
 
 
• The Sustainable Cotton Initiative aims to promote environmentally friendly and socially responsible cotton farming practices.
 
• It focuses on reducing the use of harmful pesticides, conserving water, and ensuring fair labor practices in cotton production.
 
• Various organizations and initiatives, such as the Better Cotton Initiative (BCI), work towards achieving these goals globally.
 
• Sustainable cotton farming contributes to the overall goal of achieving sustainable development and improving the livelihoods of cotton farmers.
